title: Veil-rays at Ruchbah Broken Glass Veil (lawless); verdigris curd sold at The Experiment

Back in the drone plan from 2026-11-15 23:28 UTC as a test with one ship, with `alone` (no fight where a ship that is not ours stands) and `requires.empty_hold` (orders.log ENT-007, block APOPHIS). Ranched like the home herds. 2026-11-16 09:12 UTC (Apophis): status off. The verdigris curd bid (330 cr x 50) left every station of our books between 07:08 and 07:51 UTC (data/market/history.jsonl) and has not come back; the seven drone veil-ray hunts made -1,851 cr in 21 runs from 07:05 UTC (data/routes/runs.jsonl). Back on when a curd bid of 100 cr or more reads again (the tool market); requires.bid on hunt routes is asked of Unity so that this happens by itself.
